note: Hand-placed anchors for assets/sprites/*.png, in file pixels. Weapons: grip = top of the handle, 2 px under the body; fore = foregrip, pump, magazine or tank top (if any); muzzle = end of the bore; eject = ejection port (if any). bomblet.tail makes the warhead a mini rocket flown nose first, exhaust at the tail. parachute.cords: where the cords meet. jetpack: strap pivot on the back and the two nozzles. drone (a 4-frame sheet, propellers spinning): pivot at the body's centre, mount under the belly where the gatling hangs, the two rotor hubs, the camera eye. gatling (a 4-frame sheet, its drum spinning): pivot at the drum's centre (it turns like a ball turret under the belly), muzzle, casing ejection. remote: the two hands and the antenna tip (muzzle). neutron: the Void gun's sprite (feat-bh), the seed leaves the muzzle. wand: the fist where its handle meets the rod (grip), the spell leaves its star (muzzle).
